## Goal
Describe the user outcome.

## Inputs and outputs
Specify required data and expected artifact.

## Dependencies
APIs, approvals, permissions, and credentials (never paste secrets).

## Cost and security
Budget estimate, limits, privacy, platform compliance.

## Acceptance tests
What must be verifiably working?
